mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting a contractor for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before requesting consultations or estimates, identify your primary goals and gather practical details about your home. Decide whether you want a powder room for guests, an accessible walk-in shower, or an ensuite for a multigenerational living suite. Locate your primary electrical panel and main plumbing stack if known, and check whether you have available electrical breaker capacity. It is also wise to establish a rough budget range, assemble photo ideas of preferred tile and fixture styles, and check for any neighborhood HOA architectural guidelines if building outward.
acceptedAnswer.description: Identify whether you need a half or full bath, note plumbing access locations, check your electrical panel capacity, and gather layout preferences and style ideas.
